findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The sanitizer in the sani bucket in the lobby area was measured at 0 ppm. PIC was made aware. PIC remade the sanitizer and it was tested at 300 ppm. Ensure that the concentration of the sanitizer is constantly monitored and tested to ensure adequate sanitation at all times.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: The gasket on the door of the aisle cooler walk-in section was observed to be broken and coming off. PIC was made aware. PIC assured inspector that the gasket will be fixed. Ensure that this is repair appropriately.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(B) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (B) EQUIPMENT components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a buildup of accumulated ice and frost behind the refrigeration unit and the ceiling of the walk-in freezer. Discussed with PIC and PIC informed inspector that they are aware of the build up and would get it cleaned. Ensure that the accumulated ice is cleaned providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-304.11: The ice scoop for the ice machine was observed to be stored on top of the machine touching a piece of cardboard. CORRECTED- The ice scoop was moved into a clean container. Ensure that the ice scoop storage protects the scoop from contamination.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The following maintenance is needed: 

1. REPEAT- The handwashing and dish sinks are missing caulking between the sinks and the wall. Ensure that these areas are caulked. 
2. There is a hole in the wall to the left of the door into the dry storage area. Ensure that this hole is repaired and made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

 PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: 2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: At the start of the inspection, there were no paper towels available at the kitchen hand sink. PIC stocked the paper towels during the inspection. Ensure that the hand sinks are properly stocked with all necessary items.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The sinks in the kitchen prep area are observed to need caulking where the metal meets the wall. Ensure this repaired is made to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface where moisture can not run down along the wall. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment: 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure
findings.citation_text:
5-103.11 Hot water not available at facility. 

Employees acknowledged not having hot water for several weeks. Hot water heaters sporadically work if unplugged and re-plugged. According to PIC, new hot water heaters are on order set to arrive sometime within the next week.
Jeff instructed to contact SCDPH for re-inspection prior to resuming hot hold service. 

Cease all preparation of hot held foods until cleared by SCDPH and hot water has been resumed. All food on the hot hold and rollers was voluntarily discarded at time of inspection.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Hand washing sink in the roller grill area not stocked with soap or paper towels. Sink also does not have signage designating this as a hand washing sink. Soap and paper towel dispensers were installed at the time of the inspection to correct the violation. A hand washing sign was left with the facility. 

6-301.11  (Pf) Liquid hand soap not provided at the hand washing sink. Provide liquid soap at hand washing sink. Reference 6-301.11.
6-301.14  (C) A sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. Provide a clearly visible handwashing sign at each hand sink. Reference 6-301.14.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12  (Pf) Disposable paper towels not provided at the hand washing sink. Provide disposable paper towels at hand washing sinks. Reference 6-301.12.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution in the sanitizer bucket measured at 0 ppm. Bucket was re-made to provide 200-400 ppm as instructed according to the label. The back dispenser appears as though it is not dispensing at the appropriate concentration. Manually prepare buckets until dispenser can be re-calibrated.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114  (P) Maintain concentration at 200 ppm to 400 ppm as indicated on manufacturer's label. Reference 4-501.114.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment: Half and half in the bulk dispenser has the dispensing tubes cut straight across. Cut dispensing tube at an angle as discussed.
findings.citation_text: 4-502.13  (C) Bulk milk container dispensing tube not properly cut. The bulk milk dispensing tube shall be cut on the diagonal leaving no more than 1 inch protruding from the chilled dispenser. Reference 4-502.13.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: No test strips available. Provide test strips for quaternary ammonium sanitizer solution. A couple of strips were left with the facility and they will borrow some from McDonalds until they can get some here.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14  (Pf) Test kits or other devices are not available to the employees to measure sanitizing solution concentration. Provide a test kit or other measuring device so the employees can measure concentrations and ensure proper sanitization. Avoid a concentration of sanitizer that is too high, which can be toxic. Reference 4-302.14.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
Food handlers do not have proof of successful completion of an ANSI approved food handler training program. Provide proof of completion of an ANSI approved food handler training program for each food handler. 

410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  Reference 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430.
